symbols.sig: export default function HelpManualModal({ isOpen, onClose, initialTab = "samples", isExecutive = false, onTry }: Props)

params.name: { isOpen, onClose, initialTab = "samples", isExecutive = false, onTry }

behaviours: a closed guide draws nothing
the guide opens on the sample questions, with exactly four tabs: Sample questions, Utility Services, How it works, Deep search (EDS); there is no What to type tab any more
the recipe and the weak/good pairs are shown first
every area is listed with its title
the first area is open and shows its questions with Try it and Copy; the others are closed
a [blank] is highlighted
there is a box to find a question
without a Try handler the questions carry no Try button
with a Try handler every visible question has one
the 'How it works' tab holds only what the other tabs do not say: how one Enter works, contact details (reveal and copy), the access log, languages, the red badge, the New mark, shortcuts
the 'How it works' tab points to the other tabs for the areas and the words to type, instead of listing them again
the page says, in an eye-catching banner, that these are sample questions showing what the search can handle
the two marks are explained once at the top and shown on questions: Press Enter, Appears as you type
an open area says in a boxed line how to run it, and (first) in another boxed line which button to press and what it does
the 'What to type' list is the end of the How it works tab (the selected tab), after the keyboard shortcuts, and is on no other tab
it names each group and feature, and the alternatives of a feature stand side by side with a front slash between them (silver price / 22k gold / gold price)
every string is a button that puts it in the search bar, and without a handler it is plain text
each feature says whether it appears as you type or needs Enter, and there is a box to find a feature
every feature shows a Short line and a Long line (or says why there is none), the two are explained at the top, and the commands are coloured apart
the records group is on the page: people, doctors, PAX, holidays and circulars, with their short and long questions
How it works explains short and long commands (with examples of each, the figures you type yourself and the questions) and the new DSP story tabs
the news, sports and Hindi/Bengali paper words are all there
the introduction to the search bar opens the guide: what it is (click, Ctrl + K, omnibar, backed by AI), the three steps, what can be asked, and what cannot be answered yet (plant production data)

the introduction names the buttons of the first row (Everything, People, PAX, Hospital OPD, Holidays, Degrees, Circulars & Notices), none of the Utility Services' own features, and is shown ONCE (on the first tab, not again on How it works)

nothing the Sample questions tab says is said again on How it works: not the introduction, the areas, the list of what Enter does, the sites section, the ways to find a person, the exact-phrase section, the Deep Synthesis paragraph or the 'At a glance' timings
the facts that lived only in a removed repeat are now in the sample questions (the sites, quotes and contact tips above), and the red badge and New mark timings are stated once, in their own sections
the 'Try it' explanation is said once on the Sample questions tab (not again in the box below the recipe)
the Utility Services tab says in ONE line that the calculators command opens a menu, and lists every tool of the menu (and the line is on no other tab)
How it works has a section on live cards: source, time, tabs, charts and saved figures
the Utility Services name the new features: train fares, the CPI and inflation tabs, and the RBI limit note

the Utility Services, How it works and What to type say nothing of how the deep search works (no Deep Synthesis, no briefing, no score, no executives-only badge); the first tab names the Executive Deep Search button in the picture of the bar and in its pointer under More tools, with no deep-briefing sentence; the Deep search (EDS) tab tells all
the guide opens on the Deep search tab when asked, and it is the selected tab
it begins with the scope: today uploaded circulars and announcements; later, after its success and when reliable true data is available, many more scopes; it is still being improved; who may use it
it tells an executive 'you can use it' and anyone else that they are not signed in as an executive
part 1 says what EDS is and shows five examples; part 2 shows the eight steps of an upload with the models of each; part 3 the eight steps of a question with its models; part 4 the test

the upload part says what happens to the pages: saved as 300-dpi pictures in Blob storage, read by two Gemini models (named), compared number by number, cut into 200-word chunks, embedded (768 numbers), saved in PostgreSQL on Supabase with pgvector, all or nothing; and why the OCR exists (no original PDF files)

the question part says how a line becomes a deep question (score 5), the executive check, the router, the question's vector, pgvector, up to five circulars, the writer and its fallbacks, the second reading, the guards, the stored briefing
before testing it says to check the uploaded circulars FIRST (the Circulars list and its year tabs) and to prepare a question only on those; it has the tips and fill-in shapes for making one
the list has 23 test questions, each with its needs line, a measured score badge saying it reaches EDS, Try it and Copy; and 10 more that do NOT reach EDS as typed are shown apart
the guide has a section on the management pages

it says plainly that currently only the HOD of C&IT can open them, after signing in with his own login credentials, and that he can delegate them to other executives and non-executives; anyone else is told Not allowed
all six pages are named, each with what to type: Employee manager, PAX directory editor, Circular manager, Announcement manager, Holiday manager, Contact access log

it tells what only the HOD may do (delete an employee, see and change the dates of birth and joining, authorise and withdraw) and the one page that cannot go to a non-executive (the Contact access log)
it explains how the HOD delegates: page by page, a non-executive only after his confirmation, withdrawal at once, every change in the History tab, no real person's name in the examples
the guide opens on the Utility Services tab when asked, it is the selected tab, and it replaces the other bodies
it opens with the term: a host of Utility Services given to help employees in many different ways, auxiliary to the main search, each with a bold name and the words that open it
every service is there by its bold name, and the five vehicle sub-titles under Vehicles
the words that open each service stand beside its name as buttons (one per word, each marked as you type or Enter) that put them in the search bar; without a handler they are plain text
the sample questions of the services (calculators, converters and live cards) and the notes about what the services cannot do are on this tab
none of the main features' text is on the Utility Services tab, and none of the services' is on the first tab (no sample block of the services, no calculators line)

a tab title stays readable on hover: globals.css turns every button's text primary blue on hover with !important (invisible on the guide's blue header), so the other tabs and the close cross say hover:!text-white and the chosen tab hover:!text-sky-800
the four tabs stand in this order: Sample questions, How it works, Utility Services, Deep search (EDS) (owner, 17 Nov 2026)
the heading 'What each button searches: Search in' shows 'Search in' in colour (orange, bold) inside the all-capitals heading, and 'The second row: More tools' does the same
the first tab ends its list of main features with a pointer to the Utility Services tab: a button when the guide can switch tabs
the guide's tab type is samples | utility | how | eds; the old 'types' request (a link or an event) lands on How it works, where the list now is; the pointer button switches tabs

the guide says an announcement can be a title with text, a title with a PDF, or both (one PDF of up to 10 MB), and that with both, selected words can be made a link that opens the PDF; and that the PDF is read for the search bar (and can be read again)

a picture of the bar shows both rows with the same buttons, in the same order, as the bar (read from the same lists): Everything and the six choices, then Utility Services, Executive Deep Search and Admin
the picture carries the row titles of the bar, Search in and More tools, and nothing in it can be pressed
the sample sections stand in the order of the buttons under the box, People first and Circulars & Notices last
every section's header names its button (a small label beside the count), and the open one says which button to press first

the rules of the buttons are on the first tab, once: Everything is the start and every way back lands on it, the suggestion dot, nothing found is said and never goes on to the circulars, the box is cleared when you press another button

How it works says how the bar answers (completes the line for a chosen button, says how it read the line, buttons inside answers, a wide table widens the window, nothing found is said) and what the second row does (the Utility Services page alone with Back, the executive question and Yes opening sign-in, every way back lands on Everything)
the first tab's pointers under More tools include Admin: the question, Yes opening sign-in and the check of authority, No to Everything, the red message for anyone not authorised
the old claim 'there are no search-mode buttons to choose' is gone
the keyboard list says what Esc does now: back from the Utility Services page, or close the search or this guide
the Deep search (EDS) tab says the two ways in, the button under More tools, and that the button is there for everyone and asks first
the Utility Services tab says the button under More tools opens the page too
the first tab's pointers under the second row are buttons that switch tabs when the guide can (Executive Deep Search to the Deep search tab, Utility Services to its tab)
